== Summary ==
Cover banner of [[Twilight Of The Republic (Virtual Block 9)|Twilight Of The Republic]], release 9.2 of [[Virtual Block 9]], from page 1 of its release PDF. The cover reads "Official text as of July 14, 2014". The file was created on 8 August 2014.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_2.pdf VirtualBlock9_2.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 150 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover images, and cropped to the banner (976&times;601 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020184720/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock9_2.pdf?copy=2 Internet Archive]

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-3/32/Set-VB9.2-logo.jpg Internet Archive item].
